National Trend

What's Binding Each Tier — Nationally, Aug 2026

Each store's binding constraint is its worst-scoring component — the thing most likely holding it back. Win Score and Speed dominate Tier 1 everywhere; Brand becomes the ceiling at Tier 3. This pattern is consistent across nearly every zone, so it's a fair basis for company-wide training investment, not just local coaching.
